statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). The vector r has length n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] = # { j | i < j < n and for every k with i < k < j, heights[k] < heights[i] and heights[k] < heights[j] }. In words, r[i] is the number of people strictly to the right of i whom i can see, where j is visible from i exactly when every person strictly between i and j is shorter than both i and j.
preconditions: Let n = len(heights). The slice heights satisfies 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= heights[i] <= 100000; and heights[i] != heights[j] for every 0 <= i < j < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = len(heights).

preconditions: Let n = len(heights). The slice heights satisfies 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= heights[i] <= 100000; and heights[i] != heights[j] for every 0 <= i < j < n.
